_comment: The SSH key that signs the release bot's generated commits (version-bump PRs) and release tags. Its private half is the RELEASE_BOT_SSH_SIGNING_KEY Actions secret (configured by tools/scripts/configure_release_bot_ssh_signing.sh); the public half is registered as a signing key on the danielraffel GitHub account (signing-key id below). generated_version_bump_check.py reads this file from the PROTECTED BASE only, never from the candidate, and lets a commit skip the native build matrix only when the key embedded in its GitHub-verified SSH signature has one of these fingerprints. Rotating the secret means adding the new key here on main first. See docs/guides/release-pipeline.md, 'Release bot signing'.
